issues.title: Quick Modeling
issues.notes: Connect could not perform when a ITM has a connector that is not listed in the database. It saw this as an error.

issues.title: Version Info
issues.notes: New Version Info button on the Help panel. Shows your MTechBIM version, role and expiration date, with buttons to report a bug, suggest a tool, and see what's new.

issues.title: Quick Modeling
issues.notes: Pipe xLength made the user always put in the length that they desired with no memory. Now the user can put in a length with a memory log of the last few inputs. This gives the user the ability to quickly select the length they choose if used before.
